acceptanceCriteria: An explicit claim-id reference in a record joins when the claim exists at the pinned revision, refuses when it does not; overlap joins unchanged; pinned by tests.
body: Residual of V1-1868 (PR #1165, head 4c494e642, GH #1162). Records join claims only by source-anchor path and line overlap; a record demonstrating a claim whose anchor lives elsewhere (e.g. config, another layer) is not joined.
title: docs corpus: test-knowledge claim joins beyond path/line overlap
